title: The 107 records created from the CultureMech residual have no ingredient_type
body:
Found in adversarial review of #505.

All 107 records created by `create_records_from_groundings.py` have no
`ingredient_type`. The field is not schema-required, so nothing failed -- but it is
what `WHOLE_MEDIUM_TYPES` and the NAMED_MEDIUM / UNDEFINED_MIXTURE /
SINGLE_INGREDIENT routing key off, and several of the new records are plainly not
single ingredients:

```
MICRO:0001715  Artificial seawater
MICRO:0000520  Clarified rumen fluid
MICRO:0000521  Sludge fluid
MICRO:0001598  Hemin solution
MICRO:0000456  trace metals 44
MICRO:0000567  Heart Infusion Agar
```

`classify_ingredient_type.py` lives in culturebotai-claw and is the writer for this
field, so filling it is a cross-repo run rather than something #505 should do inline
-- and claw is the repo that would otherwise overwrite whatever MIM wrote (the #148
pattern).

Until it runs, any consumer that filters on `ingredient_type` silently excludes these
107 records. `cross_reference_culturemech.py` is one such consumer: its
`WHOLE_MEDIUM_TYPES` filter is how #490 came to return a confident 0 candidates.
